en.headline: Unemployment rate rises to 3.9 percent in July to September
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted rate edged up 0.1 percentage point from the previous three-month period, with underemployment also rising to 2.0 percent.
body: Hong Kong’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate increased to 3.9 percent in the three months ending September 2026, up from 3.8 percent in June to August, the Census and Statistics Department said on Thursday.

The underemployment rate also rose by 0.1 percentage point to 2.0 percent. The number of unemployed persons increased by about 1,100 to 155,000, while the number of underemployed persons rose by about 2,900 to 75,000.

Total employment increased by around 3,000 to 3,655,000, and the labour force rose by about 4,100 to 3,810,000. Movements in unemployment rates varied across sectors, with more distinct increases in social work activities and warehousing and support activities for transportation. Underemployment rose mainly in food and beverage service activities and retail.

Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said both the labour force and total employment continued to increase as fresh graduates and school leavers entered the market. He expected sustained economic expansion, improving business sentiment and continued growth in visitor arrivals to support employment, particularly in consumption- and tourism-related sectors. The government would continue to monitor external uncertainties and provide support to job-seekers.

zh.headline: 7至9月失業率升至3.9% 就業不足率升至2%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率較前一三個月期微升0.1個百分點，失業人數增至15.5萬人。
body: 政府統計處周四公布，7月至9月經季節性調整失業率由6月至8月的3.8%上升至3.9%。就業不足率亦由1.9%升至2.0%。
失業人數增加約1,100人至155,000人，就業不足人數增加約2,900人至75,000人。總就業人數增加約3,000人至3,655,000人，總勞動人口增加約4,100人至3,810,000人。
各行業失業率變動不一，其中社會工作活動業，以及貨倉及運輸輔助活動業升幅相對明顯。就業不足率上升主要見於餐飲服務活動業及零售業。
勞工及福利局局長孫玉菱表示，勞動人口和總就業人數在應屆畢業生和離校人士繼續投入市場下進一步上升。他指本地經濟持續擴張、營商氣氛改善及訪港旅客人次繼續增長，料會為整體就業情況提供支持，尤其是消費及旅遊相關行業。政府會繼續密切留意外圍不確定因素，並為求職者提供適切支援。
